v11 Manus Major Overhaul Specification
nodes.rationale: v11 program of 8 waves × 5 phases × 10 steps = 400 checkable pieces. Defines midpoint gate as 50%-done user-visible quality. Architecture decisions: one folder per screen, public index.tsx; FlatList/SectionList with stable keys; remove persistent bottom tabs from Home; separate audio/video queues (no mixed media playlists). Source/type/mediaType/provider provenance contract lives in src/types/media.ts as a priority migration item. Player acceptance matrix: native-confirmed transport, queue/transitions, loading/recovery states, track continuity, UI/UX quality, lifecycle, local/remote/offline, verification gate. Player completion rule: W5-P27–W5-P30 + W6 phases stay In progress until matrix evidenced for both audio and video.

nodes.label: v11 Music Player Redesign
nodes.rationale: Replaces the half-complete audio player with one production contract shared by expanded overlay + mini-player. Confirmed defects in source: handleGoBack() pauses mpv on close (must collapse to mini without pausing); mini-player progress uses TransportContext not Redux; artwork uses uri not artworkUri; subtitle repeats title; controls alias rewind/forward to skip icons; queue transitions lack single command. Player modes: Expanded/Collapsed (chevronDown), Mini (compact card), None (cleared). Control semantics: chevronDown collapse, prevTrack/rewind10/play-pause/forward10/nextTrack/shuffle/repeat/listMusic/bookmark/list/heart. State ownership: playback module owns active entry+presentation; TransportContext owns native-confirmed position/duration/play state/buffering/cache ranges/seekability/sleep timer; Redux mirrors for persistence. Module path: src/modules/playback/audio/ (AudioPlayerModule.tsx + components/{Surface,Header,Hero,Transport,Actions,QueuePeek,Panels} + hooks/{useAudioPlayerScreen,useAudioPlaybackController}). Acceptance: mini artwork, close semantics, native-confirmed play/pause, prev/next lane-correct, loading/buffering/error/empty distinct, openPlayer() with full provenance.

nodes.label: v11 libmpv Integration Audit
nodes.rationale: Audit (22 Aug 2026) of native bridge, remote streaming, surface ownership, event delivery. Diagnosis: previous streaming failure was native lifecycle defect — mpv init was coupled to first video surface; audio playback has no surface. Hardening applied: mpv init independent of surface; loadfile rejected before init; command args use explicit arrays (no fragile string concat); event payload strings JSON-escaped; mini-player artwork/provenance preserved on empty metadata; playback state derived from idle-active/eof-reached/pause (not core-idle); pre-init property observers queued; deprecated MPV_EVENT_IDLE/TICK excluded. Reference comparison: Dusk-Labs (basic shape only), pigeonmal/react-native-video-mpv (Fabric patterns, 0.2.2), mpv-android (current maintained app), abdallahmehiz/mpvKt (archived 30 Mar 2026, must not use), marlboro-advance/mpvEx (active app reference, do not vendor). Open items: END_FILE reason, buffering properties (paused-for-cache), audio focus, TLS/CA, surface rebind test, Android Gradle native task rerun. Verification: TSC_EXIT=0, DIFF_CHECK_EXIT=0.

nodes.label: Screen Folder Contract
nodes.rationale: One folder per substantial screen, one public `index.tsx`, with co-located components/hooks/related/styles/types as justified. index.tsx is the composition root — no dumping ground. Navigation imports consume the public entrypoint only. Established ref templates: Movies/Podcasts/Music/Home/Library/Archive/Audiobooks/LiveTVScreenNew/RadioScreenNew.

nodes.label: List (FlatList/SectionList) Contract
nodes.rationale: Primary collections must use one intentional FlatList or a justified SectionList, with stable domain keys (semantic media id, NOT array index), typed renderers, integrated loading/error/empty/offline states, guarded pagination, refresh without destroying cached content. A ScrollView wrapping a virtualized list requires written justification. Fixed in P3 (QueueScreen SectionList key extractor), P4 (LinkedFolders), P5 (14 screens).

nodes.label: Media Provenance & Semantic Media-Kind Contract
nodes.rationale: Every durable media object and playback payload carries explicit provenance: `source` ('local'|'api' — coarse), `type` ('audio'|'music'|'podcast'|'audiobook'|'radio'|'video'|'movie'|'live-tv'|'archive-audio'|'archive-video' — product semantic kind), `mediaType` ('audio'|'video' — playback lane for queue safety), optional `provider` (e.g. 'jamendo'|'iptv'|'podcast-index'|'librivox'|'internet-archive' — catalog detail). Canonical implementation in src/types/media.ts. Fields must survive local scanning, linked-folder rescans, Recent, Follow, Bookmark, playlist persistence, queue conversion, download metadata, playback position updates. Missing legacy metadata normalized at boundary — never silently inferred in badge components. Priority migration item before W4-P21..P25.

nodes.label: Playback Module State Ownership
nodes.rationale: Three-layer authority for playback: (1) Playback module owns active entry + presentation; (2) TransportContext owns native-confirmed position, duration, play state, buffering, cache ranges, seekability, sleep-timer display; (3) Redux mirrors the active entry, current position, duration, playback state, queue checkpoints for Home mini-player, Recent History, Bookmarks, persistence. No UI component calls mpv directly for transitions or infers truth from stale Redux-only fields. Queue transitions centralized in one transition controller with a transition lock.

nodes.label: Native libmpv Bridge Hardening
nodes.rationale: mpv init independent of any video surface (audio-only remote streams can load without TextureView/Surface callback); loadfile rejected before init; commands use explicit arg arrays, no string concatenation; event payload strings JSON-escaped (quotes, backslashes, control chars, U+0020) to prevent corruption; mini-player artwork preserved; idle-active/eof-reached/pause derive playback state (not core-idle); pre-init property observers queued; deprecated MPV_EVENT_IDLE/TICK excluded. Bridge reference: Dusk-Labs/react-native-mpv (basic only), pigeonmal/react-native-video-mpv (Fabric patterns), mpv-android (active maintained app). Do NOT use: abdallahmehiz/mpvKt (archived).

nodes.label: Player Production Acceptance Matrix
nodes.rationale: Release gate for AudioPlayer + VideoPlayer. Eight areas: (1) native-confirmed transport — play/pause/stop/seek/prev/next/replay/volume/mute/speed/repeat/shuffle reconcile with mpv + Redux; (2) queue/transitions — explicit lane, queue before playlist, audio/video never cross lanes; (3) loading/recovery — preparing/initializing/loading/ready/playing/paused/buffering/ended/failed/recovering each distinct UI + enabled state + copy; (4) track continuity — subtitle/audio tracks refresh on every load, applied when supported, no stale controls; (5) UI/UX quality — stable touch targets, accessible labels, no dead controls; (6) lifecycle — nav/backgrounding/rotation/interruption/restart/sign-out/mini expand/PiP all per policy; (7) local/remote/offline — each path correct; (8) verification — full TS/lint/build/tests/device playback before W5/W6 marked Done.

nodes.label: Spec/Tracker Lifecycle Pattern
nodes.rationale: Repeated pattern across all UI/UX waves: a Specification doc (what/why/rules) is paired 1:1 with a Progress Tracker doc (phases/gates/completion). New waves introduce v(N+1) spec + v(N+1) tracker; previous v(N) is marked DEPRECATED but kept for diff history; the live base is the highest non-deprecated version (currently v4 spec is the Simba base, v10.1 is the elevation umbrella, v10.2 is the wave-specific working doc for Podcasts). v10.2 also introduces a split-doc convention: umbrella stays at v10.1, the wave gets a dedicated v(N+1) doc when the wave is multi-phase.

nodes.label: FAB-Only Browse Shell Contract (v10.1)
nodes.rationale: Locked shell anatomy inherited verbatim by every v10 wave: SimbaStatusBar → InternalHeader → SearchBar → active-only FilterChips slot → ONE content stream → gold SectionFab (badge = active filter count) → SectionOptionsSheet (FILTER / SORT / VIEW / Reset). Tabs are forbidden — legacy TabView/TabBar/tab-scene is deleted in every wave. States inside the list are uniform: centered load pill, ErrorState+retry (offline-aware), EmptyState, offline-aware banner, gold RefreshControl with floating pill, in-flow 56px footer (load-more/retry/all-caught-up). Per-scope cache is the universal key strategy.

nodes.label: Per-Scope Cache Keying
nodes.rationale: Cache key = `${categoryId}|${term}` — sort NEVER re-keys the scope (client-side only). Each scope carries `{items, maxRequested, hasLoaded, isLoading, isLoadingMore, error, categoryId, term}`; per-key seqRef + guardRef drop stale responses; load-more doubles max 25→100 (no true offset). When API supports sort, it's server-side; otherwise copy-then-sort the loaded slice on a memo (Music/Podcasts pattern).
